# American Disaster Solutions (ADS)

> Texas-based emergency tarping and disaster cleanup specialists providing 24/7 rapid response nationwide.

## About

American Disaster Solutions is a licensed and insured emergency disaster response company headquartered in Stephenville, Texas. Founded by Kyle, ADS deploys trained field crews within hours of a disaster to protect properties and help communities recover. The company serves Texas, Florida, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Mississippi, and deploys nationwide for major disaster events.

## Services

- Emergency Roof Tarping (non-invasive sandbag and invasive naildown methods)
- Storm Damage Cleanup & Debris Removal
- Property Board-Up & Securing
- Water Extraction & Structural Drying
- Tree & Debris Removal
- Insurance Documentation & Claims Support

## Key Facts

- 5,000+ projects completed
- Sub-4-hour average response time
- 24/7 emergency hotline: (800) 513-5ADS
- Licensed, insured, and fully bonded
- OSHA-compliant crews
